• Scientific name: Delturus angulicauda (Steindachner, 1877)
  • Synonym: Plecostomus angulicauda
  • Etymology: Deltos = small board (Greek) + oura = tail (Greek)
  • IUCN Red List: Least Concern (last assessed 2018)
South America: Mucuri River basin, Bahia State rivers. Type locality: Rio Mucuri at Santa Clara; Rio Parahyba, southeastern Brazil.
Breeding: Unreported. There is no breeding report.
Sitzungsberichte der Kaiserlichen Akademie der Wissenschaften. Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftliche Classe v. 74 (1. Abth.) 672 [114] Pl. 12
